_meta.title: Government restrictions and social hostilities involving religion, 2007-2022 (Pew Research Center, excerpt)
_meta.what: value = Government Restrictions Index 2022 (0-10; higher = more government restriction of religion). Also the Social Hostilities Index (0-10; acts by private people and groups) for every year 2007-2022, and the 2022 answers on whether government or social groups harassed or intimidated each religious group (0 = no, 0.5 = limited, 1 = widespread).
_meta.source: Pew Research Center, Global Restrictions on Religion 2007-2022 dataset, as distributed by the ARDA (DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/MNQSJ)
